subject: Startups
title: Africa's Fintech Unicorns
description: A fast breakdown of Africa's Fintech Unicorns for builders.

hook.text: Flutterwave became Africa's most valuable startup at $3 billion.

buildup.text: Africa has 1.3 billion people and 54 countries with different currencies, regulations, and banking systems.

discovery.text: Fintech unicorns like Flutterwave and Chipper Cash solve real infrastructure gaps.

twist.text: Scaling across Africa means negotiating with dozens of regulators. Each country has different rules for money movement.

climax.text: African fintech funding grew 10x between 2019 and 2022. The continent is the next frontier for unicorn creation.

punchline.text: Where banks won't go, fintech unicorns step in.

quiz.question: What drives fintech unicorn growth in Africa?
options: Infrastructure gaps where digital payments fill the void
